entity.name: three.ws
entity.description: three.ws builds an open-source browser platform for embodied 3D AI agents: text-to-3D generation, rigged avatar creation and animation, an embeddable agent-3d web component and Model Context Protocol servers.

projects.name: three.ws
projects.description: The three.ws platform: a browser-based studio and runtime for 3D AI agents, with text-to-3D, avatars, animation retargeting, hosted agents with wallets, and an embeddable agent-3d web component.

projects.name: @three-ws/mcp-server
projects.description: A Model Context Protocol server that lets any MCP client generate 3D models and avatars, read and write agent data and pay for services through three.ws.

projects.name: agent-3d web component and viewer
projects.description: The embeddable agent-3d web component and glTF viewer that put a live animated 3D avatar on any website.

channels.description: Subscriptions and metered usage on three.ws, paid by card or USDC, fund development of the open-source platform.

plans.name: Pro subscription
plans.description: More hosted agents, automations and a larger free allowance. Revenue funds platform development.

plans.name: Team subscription
plans.description: Room for a fleet of agents and the automations that run them. Revenue funds platform development.

plans.name: Enterprise subscription
plans.description: Unlimited agents and automations, dedicated capacity and a named contact. Revenue funds platform development.
